invariants.rationale: The method accesses style.* fields unconditionally, so style must not be null at method entry.
If the component is disabled, the method accesses style.disabledFontColor, so null access is only safe if !isDisabled() or style.disabledFontColor != null.
If style.overFontColor is null, the code path where (isOver() || scrollPane.hasParent()) must not be taken.
The method always returns one of the style.*FontColor fields, falling back to style.fontColor, so style.fontColor must be non-null to avoid returning null.
